reviews.text: Great experience with the Premiere Training package. Allie was super communicative from the beginning. Taking the time to talk me through options when our dog was a young puppy, months before I made my decision, and all throughout our dogs 4 week stay. Providing frequent photo and text updates of his progress while he was away. He's been home for almost four months now and he's maintained his obedience training. Highly recommend!

Hi Suzy. Our records show you've never been a client of All Canine Training. Because of that, this review does not reflect an actual customer experience and appears to be a retaliatory after a review left for your company. The review has been reported to google for removal.

Allie is the BEST! If you are looking for a dog trainer who cares, is consistent, with exceptional results look no further. We came to Allie through a referral from a close friend, after a terrible experience with a larger dog training company in the Cave Creek area. After investing thousands of dollars and seeing close to zero results we were initially hesitant to invest more money in our lab's training. However after one phone call with Allie I felt like we were going to be in good hands. She took the time to explain her process in detail, and right away I could tell she truly cares about her service and the dogs she supports. Our chocolate lab did the 3 week training course with Allie with a follow up session, and all I can say is that our results are literally night and day. Our dog is now extremely well mannered and was SO receptive to the training. We seriously have had to do hardly any training after brining her back home. The training truly stuck after this program and we could not be happier. Allie's work has made our process at home so much easier. I cannot speak more highly or recommend her enough! 10/10

Allie was very knowledgeable and professional.   Mia and I were learning fast through her guidance.  Mia and I are still training but glad I used All Canine to get us down the right path to a better relationship.  Thank you Allie, Tom and Mia.  Ps...photo taken on the couch before the training..lol

Allie has been an absolute lifesaver and godsend for our family. For over five years, she has been our go-to trainer, support system, and trusted expert for our dog. From board & trains, group classes, and private lessons to daycare and boarding, she has truly been there for us with patience, consistency, and so much heart.

Our dog is human-reactive, and without Allie’s guidance we simply wouldn’t have the tools, confidence, or understanding we have today. She has given us structure, skills, and a deeper connection with our dog that we didn’t think was possible. “Thankful” doesn’t even begin to describe how we feel about the work she has poured into our pup over the years.

Allie is dedicated, knowledgeable, honest, and incredibly skilled at what she does. We trust her fully, and our dog absolutely adores her. If you’re looking for someone who will show up for you and your dog in every way, look no further. Allie is the best there is, and we are forever grateful for everything she has done for our family.

After getting our first dog, Stone — a 1.5-year-old Golden Retriever — we knew we wanted to invest in proper training. Having a well-behaved dog was really important to us, especially with how busy and structured our lives are. We wanted to be able to bring Stone everywhere with us and feel confident that he could handle different environments and distractions.

A client of mine highly recommended Allie, so we enrolled Stone in her 4-week training program. I’ll be honest — I wasn’t entirely sure what to expect going into it, and it was definitely hard leaving him for four weeks. But I decided to trust the process, and I’m so glad I did.

When we got Stone back, we were beyond happy with his progress. He was still the same happy, goofy boy we love, but now he knows how to manage his excitement and stay calm in situations where it’s needed. The biggest change for me personally has been how much better I can communicate with him — he understands what I’m asking, and I know exactly how to guide him when new situations come up.

It’s been about a month since we’ve had him back, and everyday life feels so much easier. We can take him places without any anxiety about how he’ll behave, and that’s been such a game changer. I can confidently say this experience was 100% worth it, and I’ll absolutely do this training again with any future dogs we have.

We’re so grateful for Allie and the foundation she helped us build with Stone!

Sending our dog Tate to Allie for her three-week board and train was the best decision we’ve made. After just two days home, we’ve seen a night-and-day difference in his impulse control and how relaxed our walks are. Allie is great at what she does, and she has a gift for understanding a dog’s unique personality and quirks. Before this program, we felt stuck and unsure how to help Tate. Now, with the progress he’s made and the tools Allie gave us, we feel fully equipped to keep building at home. Truly couldn’t recommend her more.
Our GSD is very sweet but was very reactive.  3 weeks with Allie and he’s been a new dog around children and other dogs.  Highly recommend

My almost 3 year old Goldendoodle, Frankie just recently finished a 3 week training session with Allie at All Canine Training. I couldn’t be happier with the outcome. My biggest issues were walking calmly on a lease without any aggressive issues toward other dogs along the path. After the training she is now so much more manageable and she heels so nicely. I’m looking forward to more canine classes in the future.
Allie is amazing. She is knowledgeable, passionate and patient. We were so impressed with the progress our dog made. We would recommend Allie to anyone who needs to their dog trained.

Working with Allie has been the best decision we made for our bulldog Luna
At first we were going to a previous location which we visited and we were put off with the amount of dogs there and the uncleanliness of it. However when we heard about All Canine training from our Vet we reached out to Allie and the professionalism and quick response was amazing. Then when we found out she only took 3 dogs at time for boarding and also that the dogs would spend time in her house was a deal sealer!! The area our dog slept was nice and the training grounds were modern and had grass and shelter. The amazing change we saw with our 8 month old Bulldog was amazing and how happy our dog was even returning to see Allie for some post training was amazing to see. She was an amazing dog trainer and I could see how much she loved working with dogs and the love she gave them like they were her own dogs was very refreshing!
I would highly recommend All-canine training and Allie Alldredge

A+! Our very active 2 yr. old dog went to boarding/training for two weeks while we were out of county. I had no worries about leaving him with Allie. The day after pickup, we were walking at the park and another dog trainer used us as a “good” example of what to expect of their dog! No pulling and no reactions to other dogs, which was a problem.  I cannot say enough good things about our experience.  We have a very well-behaved dog that is much more calm.  Thank you!

Choosing a board and train program for my dog was a tough decision, and trust was my biggest concern. From the moment I spoke with Allie, I felt a wave of relief; I knew my boy would be in wonderful hands. I truly appreciated the updates and the genuine care she provided, especially as he navigated through an ear infection. It was clear that she went above and beyond for him.

The program has truly transformed our communication. My dog now understands my expectations when I ask him to follow a command, which has made a remarkable difference. He’s much more confident and much calmer during our outings. While he remains the same goofy, loving boy I’ve always known, he now has the essential tools to succeed. Thank you, Allie and the entire All Canine Training team, for helping my boy gain the confidence and structure he so desperately needed. Your dedication has made such a positive impact on our lives.

Allie is amazing! After the three week board and train program I can confidently take my dog off leash to the park and on hikes, and he has so much more obedience in and out of the house. During the process Allie was very responsive to any and all questions and was very supportive. Also, her prices are very reasonable compared to other board and train programs. I would highly recommend her to anyone.
Allie is a great instructor and would always use her with our dogs.

We just got our boy back from 2 weeks of training and we are so pleased. It's been less than 24 hours  and it's been so rewarding to not only see the difference in his obedience but to feel empowered to maintain what he's to learned at home. Allie is so thorough with instructions and was a joy to work with.

We are incredibly grateful to Allie and All Canine Training for the amazing progress our dogs, Tango and Cha Cha, have made!

Tango (6yo) struggled with reactivity, and Cha Cha (2.5yo) dealt with fear and anxiety. Both completed the board-and-train programs, and the results have been life-changing! Prior to training, we hardly walked our dogs because it caused so much stress for them and us. Now we go on walks nearly every day!

Allie’s kindness and attention to detail stood out from the start—she asked thoughtful questions, got to know our dogs, and made tailored recommendations. The home-like environment provided so much comfort, knowing our dogs weren’t in a kennel-style facility. During our follow-up visit, they were thrilled to see her again! She was nearly an hour drive from our home, but it was well worth it!

Two months since coming home, they’re calmer, more confident, and walking beautifully on a leash. Our friends & family have been shocked at the transformation.

Thank you, Allie, for transforming the lives of us and our dogs, and for giving us the tools to enjoy life with them even more!!

We are so very grateful for Allie and the training she provided for our dogs. She is professional yet remains compassionate and caring. We so appreciate her expertise and dedication to dogs. It is evident that she cares for her "students" (the canines and the humans). Allie is direct, honest, and skilled. We trusted her completely and we were so pleased with the progress made after 2 weeks. Her follow up with her "graduates" is above and beyond. We will joyfully and confidently recommend her to anyone in need of canine training. We were at the end of our searching and our patience when we found her. Allie's dedicated training has made all the difference with our pack!

Allie is an amazing trainer!!! I can’t thank her enough for helping me with my chocolate lab. She is doing amazing. I can actually enjoy our walks now without her dragging me lol or  barking at every little thing. Seriously Allie is the best.

Absolutely thrilled with the results from Allie! She worked wonders with our two puppies, turning them into well-behaved and great companions. Her patience, expertise, and personalized approach made all the difference. We couldn't be happier with the progress our pups have made under her guidance. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dog trainer!

I brought my new rescue German Shepherd to Allie for a three-week training course after he displayed serious reactivity to people, bikes, and cars.  After giving through Allie’s training, he came back a confident, obedient, non-reactive pup.

Allie also spent time working with me to make sure I knew how to read my dog’s body language, give proper corrections, and safely expose him to new environments.  It’s been two weeks since he came home from training and he is a much better behaved dog and I’m no longer worried about his ability to safely walk around in public.

I highly recommend Allie’s training program.

Allie is the best! She takes amazing care of my two frenchies when I’m away and always makes sure to send picture updates which make my day. She is so kind and responsive, and referred by a great friend! Highly recommend!

Allie trained our dog Lemon for a few weeks. Although Lemon was a good dog with decent manners, she come a stellar dog with extraordinary manners. Allie was sure to send us frequent updates- including professional looking photos - to keep …

All canine training has become the only place we will leave our dog. He is a jack russell and a ball of energy and Allie knows his personality. She comes up with great activites/training to keep him busy so he is mentally and physically challenged!

Allie trained my first Service Dog whom I’ve had for nearly 8 years; everyone remarks about how well behaved Bert is in every situation. As Bert must retire in the next 7 months, I contacted Allie to find & train Bert’s successor. Allie …

Highly recommend Allie at All canine training. Tater, our French bulldog loves training with Allie. He has become such a great addition to our family. He was a rescue pup with some issues. With training he has become a great pup!

Beautiful location.  Training with care and professionalism.  Allie's presence and confidence commands a room.  I witnessed a mini ausie who's usually very excitable and has never seen Allie before...walk over to Allie and sit in front of her and wait attentively.  The dog knew who's the boss and was waiting for any command. 🐾❤️ …
